TC-20/S23.title: Nursing Home dashboard tabs: switching moves rows and counts; list search / sort / tab do not leak in
TC-20/S23.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 3/3. Opened from the list searched for 'Ada', sorted by name, on All Residents: the dashboard is on Today's Visits with the same tiles as a plain open (7/3/3/1). Its All Residents tab shows 9/4/3/2 = every stored resident, Fay and Gus listed (full counts 0.6 s after the tap; Q3: counts follow the tab); back on Today's Visits 7/3/3/1 without Fay.
